name: GlobeXAI — Full Webhook Execution Workflow (Docker & Direct)

parameters.content:
## ⚡ GLOBEX LIVE WEBHOOK EXECUTION WORKFLOW

**RESPONSE MODE:**
- `responseMode: responseNode` ➔ Webhook calls will wait and return the full synthesized JSON back to your frontend in real time!

**BACKEND TARGET:**
- `http://host.docker.internal:8000` (Docker) / `http://localhost:8000`

**TO USE FROM FRONTEND:**
1. Import this workflow in n8n.
2. Toggle top-right switch to **Active**.
3. In your frontend (`http://localhost:5173/trade-analysis`), click **`Execute in n8n`**!
